description:
The `gf2-algebra::permanent` module overview points to two removed `dev/plans/` paths although the authoritative design documents live under the archived gf2-algebra epic.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The permanent module rustdoc resolves both design references to their authoritative archived artifacts without copying design facts into a second source.
- [hard] REQ-02: `cargo doc -p gf2-algebra --all-features --no-deps` succeeds and a repository search finds no live production rustdoc reference to either removed path.

## Resolution

Subsumed by overhaul issue `ec655592` (REQ-03, REQ-04): every `dev/plans/` citation in Rustdoc points to the plan's archived path or is removed.
title: Repair archived design links in permanent module rustdoc
